patch_description: The main runtime bottleneck is `_climb`: every candidate move recomputes all 286 triangle areas plus the hull. When moving a single point i, only the ~66 triangles containing i change. Maintaining a cached area array and recomputing only affected rows (while still recomputing the cheap 13-point hull exactly) makes each climb step ~4x faster, letting us widen Stage 2 polish from top-14 to top-20 and increase climb iterations substantially within the same wall-clock budget. This converts directly into higher min_area_normalized, per the recommendation from Gen 36's proven approach.
